useWhen: Analyzing SaaS business metrics to diagnose health
Interpreting MRR, ARR, churn, and other SaaS metrics
Benchmarking against industry standards by stage
Identifying root causes of metric underperformance
Creating action plans tied to specific metric improvements

workflow.description: Collect metrics, classify by type (leading/lagging) and funnel stage (AARRR)
Apply health scorecard with stage-appropriate benchmarks, grade metrics Green/Yellow/Red
Trace causal chains from lagging indicators to leading root causes
Analyze metrics over time, compare cohorts, identify direction of change
Compare against industry benchmarks for company stage and segment
Synthesize into diagnosis and prioritized action plan with specific metric targets

examples.input: Analyze our SaaS metrics: MRR $50K, 500 customers, 8% monthly churn, CAC $500, LTV $6,000. We're at $50K MRR, growing 10% month-over-month.
examples.output:
**METRICS INVENTORY**

| Metric | Value | Type | Stage |
|--------|-------|------|-------|
| MRR | $50K | Lagging | Revenue |
| Customers | 500 | Lagging | Acquisition |
| Churn | 8% | Lagging | Retention |
| CAC | $500 | Leading | Acquisition |
| LTV | $6,000 | Lagging | Revenue |

**HEALTH SCORECARD** (Early-stage SMB)

| Metric | Value | Benchmark | Status |
|--------|-------|-----------|--------|
| MRR Growth | 10%/mo | 15-20%/mo | Yellow |
| Churn | 8%/mo | 5-7%/mo | Red |
| LTV:CAC | 12:1 | 3:1 | Green |
| ARPU | $100 | $50-200 | Green |

**DIAGNOSIS**
Primary issue: High monthly churn (8%) is unsustainable. Root cause analysis shows:
- High churn → Low activation → Poor onboarding
- 8% monthly churn = ~60% annual churn = unhealthy

**ROOT CAUSE CHAIN**
```
8% monthly churn (symptom)
  ↓
Low activation rate: 25% (root)
  ↓
Users don't complete onboarding in first 7 days
  ↓
No in-app guidance or onboarding flow
```

**BENCHMARK COMPARISON**
- Churn: 8% vs 5-7% benchmark = 1-3% above (Red)
- LTV:CAC: 12:1 vs 3:1 = Very high (possible under-investment)

**ACTION PLAN**

| Priority | Action | Metric Target | Impact |
|----------|--------|---------------|--------|
| 1 | Add onboarding flow | Activation 25%→50% | Churn 8%→5% |
| 2 | Implement in-app tips | Feature adoption +30% | Churn 5%→4% |
| 3 | Set up re-engagement email | Day-3 retention +20% | Churn 4%→3.5% |

**MONITORING**
- Review: Weekly
- Target: Churn <5% in 3 months

examples.input: Our metrics: ARR $500K, 200 enterprise customers, 2% monthly churn, CAC $5,000, ACV $60,000. Growing 5% month-over-month.
examples.output:
**METRICS INVENTORY**

| Metric | Value | Type | Stage |
|--------|-------|------|-------|
| ARR | $500K | Lagging | Revenue |
| Customers | 200 | Lagging | Acquisition |
| Churn | 2% | Lagging | Retention |
| CAC | $5,000 | Leading | Acquisition |
| ACV | $60,000 | Lagging | Revenue |

**HEALTH SCORECARD** (Growth-stage Enterprise)

| Metric | Value | Benchmark | Status |
|--------|-------|-----------|--------|
| ARR Growth | 5%/mo | 10-15%/mo | Red |
| Churn | 2%/mo | 1-2%/mo | Yellow |
| LTV:CAC | 12:1 | 3:1 | Green |
| Net Revenue Retention | 110% | 110-120% | Yellow |

**DIAGNOSIS**
Primary issue: Slow ARR growth (5%/mo vs 10-15% benchmark). Root cause analysis:
- Slow growth → Low new customer acquisition
- Low acquisition → High CAC or weak sales pipeline

**ROOT CAUSE CHAIN**
```
5% ARR growth (symptom)
  ↓
Low new customer rate: 3/mo (root)
  ↓
Sales cycle lengthening: 90→120 days
  ↓
Limited pipeline, high CAC concerns
```

**ACTION PLAN**

| Priority | Action | Metric Target | Impact |
|----------|--------|---------------|--------|
| 1 | Expand sales pipeline | New customers 3→6/mo | Growth +5%→8% |
| 2 | Add self-serve tier | SMB segment, lower CAC | Acquisition +30% |
| 3 | Improve NRR | NRR 110%→120% | Growth +8%→12% |

**MONITORING**
- Review: Monthly
- Target: ARR growth >10% in 6 months
